descriptions.e14b_string_compact_800c4a7c: Compact the two-pointer text buffer behind self+4 after dropping its 33-byte header: if the buffer is non-empty, assign its begin text to the caller's string object, copy the body down over the header unless begin+33 already equals the end, and lower the end pointer by the header size; returns the original failure status 0x80004005 for an empty buffer and 0 on success.
